scoring_justification: The headline values come from a fitting procedure requiring experimental data from multiple papers; the checker compares agent's reported fitted values against the paper's Table 1 reference values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for computed table (t_nm, B, tau_MPa, sigma_i_MPa, Lc_um) from paper Table 1.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Effects of interphase on tensile strength of polymer/CNT nanocomposites by Kelly-Tyson theory', Table 1.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from the published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results, used as the reproduction target.

outputs.description: Table of computed interphase thickness, Pukanszky B parameter, interfacial shear strength, interphase strength, and critical CNT length for five polymer/CNT nanocomposite samples. Values are compared against hidden reference results with appropriate per-parameter tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The scored file must contain exactly five rows corresponding to the five samples (PP/MWCNT, PS/MWCNT, PDCPD/f-MWCNT, PEEK/f-MWCNT, Epoxy/f-MWCNT) in the order given by the extracted experimental data. All columns are required.
